base_url.label: Base URL
base_url.description: Enter the base URL, such as https://yourcompany.freshdesk.com.

access_token.label: API Token
access_token.description: Get the API token by visiting your profile settings and clicking View API key

get_contact_from_id.label: Get Contact from ID
get_contact_from_id.description: Get contacts details from Freshdesk using ID number.

contactid.label: Contact ID number
contactid.description: The ID number of the contact

get_ticket_status.label: Get Ticket Status
get_ticket_status.description: Get Ticket status from Freshdesk. Returns ticket_status, assigned_status, assigned_id

ticketid.label: Ticket ID
ticketid.description: The Ticket ID to return status

get_contacts.label: Get Contacts
get_contacts.description: Get contact details from Freshdesk for all (optional filtered) contacts.

filter_type.label: Optional Filter
filter_type.description: Select one and provide the value.

filter_value.label: Filter value
filter_value.description: The value to filter by, for the filter chosen above.

filter_status.label: Optional Filter Status
filter_status.description: Can filter by state: blocked, deleted, unverified or verified.

per_page.label: Results to return
per_page.description: Freshdesk calls this per_page - set to 0 for all, if specified maximum is 100

get_all_tickets_by_status.label: Get All Tickets By Status
get_all_tickets_by_status.description: Get All Tickets by selected status from Freshdesk.

status_filter.label: Statuses
status_filter.description: One or more statuses, as a list such as ["status:2", "status:3"]. Open is status:2, Pending status:3, Resolved status:4 and Closed status:5.
